text:
{"content":"Show a localized explanation when the selected calendar fails validation. If the calendar becomes unwritable before Save, the controller returns invalid and retains the draft. The dialog sets aria-invalid but clears the status message. The user receives no visible explanation or correction advice.","codeSuggestion":"","assessment":"Confirmed by source inspection. This is an independent finding. The required renderer change is in unchanged code.","rationale":"calendar-event-create-save.mjs records calendar validity at lines 97–110 and reports event-validation-failed at line 124. #renderSave displays an error only for event-save-failed. #renderCalendar sets aria-invalid at line 627 but renders no error text. The production calendar selector has no error description.","recommendation":"change","validation":"The unit test checks unwritable calendars. browser_calendarEventCreateSave.js checks only aria-invalid and the accessible invalid state at lines 292–305. It does not check a calendar error message. Runtime confirmation remains incomplete.","appliedSummary":"Changed the [dialog](/Users/aschmitz/projects/fox/comm/mail/components/calendar/content/calendar-event-create-edit-dialog.mjs:553), [Fluent strings](/Users/aschmitz/projects/fox/comm/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/calendarDialog.ftl:229), and [browser test](/Users/aschmitz/projects/fox/comm/mail/components/calendar/test/browser/browser_calendarEventCreateSave.js:314).

Calendar validation errors now show a localized message linked to the selector. Added a test for retained values, zero transactions, error feedback, and successful retry.

Focused commlint, syntax, and whitespace checks passed. The browser test was not run: matching binaries remain unconfirmed (`SourceStamp=unknown`).

The diff follows the recorded patterns. Evidence assessment remains incomplete because the accepted description-link example comes from another component.
